fields.Name: Integration Test: Avatar Self-Service
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role for the self-service avatar mutation (UpdateMyAvatar). Grants READ ONLY on 'MJ: Users' — the shape of a locked-down deployment, where users can see user records but cannot update them (a row filter cannot restrict columns, so own-row Update would also expose Email). The self-avatar-client bundle proves the mutation still works for a user holding only this role, and that the plain entity save is refused. Safe to delete; assign only to the seeded it-avatar-* test accounts.

fields.Name: Integration Test: Avatar User Editor
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role for the self-service avatar mutation (UpdateMyAvatar). Grants READ and UPDATE on 'MJ: Users' — the contrast leg: the self-avatar-client bundle proves the mutation also works for a user who could have saved the row directly. Safe to delete; assign only to the seeded it-avatar-* test accounts.
